Chapter 6910: Too Fast

Chapter 6910: Too Fast

Stygian seemingly disappeared and turned into a beam for a direct hit on Li Qiye.

The barriers concocted by Guardian Alliance nearly exploded from the impact. Fortunately, they held firm. Some shockwaves still leaked through, affecting the nearby major worlds.

The beam had a temporal effect, causing everything outside of Stygian to become one beat slower.

“What is going on?” An immortal outside shuddered: “The foundation of Stygian, this is a primordial-level fight.”

“Gu Chun and Skyshroud joined the battle?” Another immortal said.

“Who is their opponent?” Immortals everywhere wanted to watch. Alas, Stygian was a dangerous place to be, not to mention the blockade barriers.

They contemplated the few opponents capable of forcing Stygian to this desperate measure.

Primordial immortals from Guardian Alliance couldn’t have done this since Devouring Alliance had their own primordial immortals. It had to be someone above this level.

“Eternal Sacred Teacher?” They came up with this answer.

He brought primordial chaos true energy to three thousand worlds and planted primordial trees. Primordial immortals couldn’t do this. Thus, he had to be at the celestial level.

Unfortunately, he rarely appeared in history and never fought anyone. Therefore, they had no grasp of his cultivation.

“It might be Empress Hong Tian. She has been at the primordial stage for a long time, perhaps she has crossed the ocean.” An immortal said.

“Maybe, but Guardian Alliance is still outside.” Another responded.

Meanwhile, the beam continued to pulse on Li Qiye, wanting to disintegrate him. Guangmai also made his move at the same time, showing the speed and power of a primordial immortal. He may have been a split second faster than the beam.

His target was not Li Qiye but the world’s heart floating above. The process was hard to describe since Stygian was no longer around. The beam created an eternal passage devoid of other affinities.

In theory, this was his best opportunity since the beam was assaulting Li Qiye’s three temporal flows.

However, Guangmai saw Li Qiye smiling somehow. He believed he was the fastest and the only one untethered by the beam.

He felt something was wrong but the heart was an inch away from grasp. Fear was overshadowed by excitement the moment he touched the heart. Nothing else mattered.

“Boom!” The passage collapsed since Li Qiye nullified it by just standing there.

“Ahh!” A scream came next, accompanied by gushing flesh and blood. Guangmai’s hand holding the heart was ripped off by Li Qiye.

The immortals shaping the beam also staggered backward. Stygian appeared again before everyone.

“Not bad, faster than an eternal passage, that’s a primordial immortal for you.” Li Qiye threw the severed hand away.

Guangmai turned pale. His body was immensely tough. Damaging it was nearly impossible, let alone severing a limb.

Worst of all, he didn’t see Li Qiye’s movement or chosen power. He could see the techniques and power affinity of a celestial immortal, just not anything from this mortal.

Guangmai stared at him as if he were looking at a freak of nature or a ghost. Of course, he could have destroyed anything supernatural with his cultivation.

He didn’t feel this much dread even when Genesis nearly killed him.
